models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description:
Stores sales channel configurations for different distribution methods including online store and mobile app platforms.

Manages the fundamental channels through which products are sold, encompassing all branding options, seasonal configurations, and platform-specific settings. Each channel serves as a root node in the content hierarchy, with sections organized under each channel.

Channels are independently managed by administrators to enable channel-specific branding, feature toggles, and marketing configurations. This entity serves as the primary reference for all channel-specific operations and system settings.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Channel name identifier (e.g., 'web', 'mobile'). Must be unique across all channels.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description or purpose of the channel.

plainFields.name: branding_settings
plainFields.description: Configuration details for channel branding including colors, logos, and layout preferences.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the channel configuration.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was soft-deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description:
Sections within sales channels for organizing content hierarchically. Each section belongs to a specific channel and can have nested subsections to create multi-level content structures.

Sections serve as organizational containers for products and content within sales channels. They support hierarchical relationships by allowing sections to have parent-child relationships, enabling flexible arrangement of content. Sections require unique names per channel to prevent naming conflicts in the same channel context.

foreignFields.name: channel_id
foreignFields.description: The sales channel this section belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent section for hierarchical organization. {@link shopping_mall_sections.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the section for user-facing display and organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the section's purpose and content structure.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was soft-deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description:
System-wide configuration settings and feature flags that control platform behavior and functionality.

This table stores application-level settings that determine platform features and operational parameters. Each configuration entry has a unique key identifier, a value stored as string (supporting serialization of complex data), a type classification for validation, and descriptive documentation. The system tracks configuration changes and allows safe soft deletion for recovery purposes.

Admins use this API endpoint to enable/disable features, adjust runtime parameters, and configure system behavior without requiring code changes. The value field accommodates various formats (booleans, integers, JSON) through string-based storage and application-side de-serialization.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting (e.g., enable_payments, max_order_value). Required for configuration lookup and management.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Current value of the configuration (as a string). Supports serialization of complex types for flexible usage.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Expected data type of the configuration (e.g., boolean, string, integer). Used for client-side validation and error handling.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration's purpose and usage for admin reference.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft-deleted (null if currently active).

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Core customer accounts with profile information and login credentials for shopping platform users.

Manages user authentication details, profile data, and account status. Each customer has a unique email address and securely hashed password for login. Supports soft deletion for account management without permanent data loss.

Email verification tokens are managed separately in a dedicated table to maintain clean separation of identity and session administration.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address used for login and notifications. Must be unique across all customers to ensure account uniqueness.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using industry-standard algorithms. Never stores plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp. Always populated when account is created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp for account modifications. Automatically updated on any change to profile or security settings.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp indicating when account was marked for deletion (not immediately removed).

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions tracking valid login states and tokens for customer accounts. Each session is linked to a specific customer and includes connection context for audit and security purposes. Session tokens expire after configured intervals to maintain security. The table enables tracking login locations, sources, and session duration for security analysis and user activity monitoring.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's authentication session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL used for session establishment.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires for security. Must be specified, no unlimited sessions.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Seller accounts for business entities listing and managing products on the platform.

Manages registered business accounts that can list products, manage their commerce storefronts, and handle product inventory. Each seller has a unique email with verification requirements to prevent fake accounts.

Sellers can independently access their account settings, product listings, and order management without dependency on other entity contexts. All seller accounts follow the authentication security policies including automatic account lockouts after failed login attempts.

Seller authentication requires password hashing following industry security standards, and account status tracks verification progress from registration through final approval.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Business or company name of the seller, used for public display in product listings and storefronts.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's primary email address for account authentication and communication. Must be globally unique across all sellers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stores plaintext credentials. Follows bcrypt standard for password security.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current verification status of the seller account. Valid values: 'unverified', 'pending', 'active', 'suspended', 'banned'. Tracks progression through the verification workflow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to seller account details or status.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the seller account was soft-deleted. Null indicates active account.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking valid login states and tokens specifically for seller accounts.

This table stores all active sessions for seller users, including connection context and security-relevant metadata. Each session is authenticated through a corresponding seller account and requires explicit expiration to maintain security compliance.

Session data includes IP address, connection URL, and referrer for audit trails. It strictly follows the required session table pattern with no denormalized data or additional fields, supporting the platform's security policies around session management and account protection.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the device from which the session was started.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL used to establish the client session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session establishment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires (enforced by system policy).

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrator accounts with elevated privileges for platform management and oversight.

Stores core admin account information including authentication credentials for secure login and access to platform management features. Requires email verification before session establishment and supports password reset functionality. Each admin account has a dedicated authentication session recorded in shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

The administrator role allows full system control including user management, content moderation, and platform configuration access. Admin accounts are managed independently from customer and seller accounts with distinct permission levels.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email address used for authentication and system notifications. Must be unique across all administrator accounts to ensure proper login functionality.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for administrator authentication. Must follow security policies with strong hashing algorithms to prevent credential exposure.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Used for audit trails and determining account age.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account data was last modified. Tracks account updates for security and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was deleted (soft delete). Null means account is active, otherwise represents termination date.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking valid login states and tokens for admin accounts.

Manages authentication sessions for administrator accounts, recording connection metadata including IP address, URL context, and session lifetimes. Each session is uniquely tied to one administrator account through the admin_id foreign key.

Session management enforces security policies by requiring session expiration (expired_at NOT NULL), preventing permanent sessions that could compromise platform security. The table captures essential audit information including connection source (referrer), URL path (href), and session creation timestamp.

This table follows the standardized session pattern established for all actor types (customers, sellers, admins) with consistent naming and field structure throughout the Actors component.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin account owner. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL for the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp (required for platform security).

models.name: shopping_mall_login_attempts
models.description:
Tracks failed login attempts for security policy enforcement.

Records each authentication failure event including user context, IP address, and failure reason to enable the system's automatic account lockout policy after 5 consecutive failures within 15 minutes.

The table supports real-time security monitoring of authentication attempts and provides necessary data for forensic analysis of potential brute force attacks. Each login attempt record is timestamped for the 15-minute window requirement of the security policy.

Soft deletion preserves audit trails while allowing security operations to mark attempts as irrelevant without removing historical data.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User account identifier for login attempts. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id.}

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: Source IP address of the failed login attempt.

plainFields.name: failure_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for authentication failure (e.g., 'invalid password', 'account locked').

plainFields.name: failed_at
plainFields.description: Exact timestamp of the failed login attempt.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the login attempt record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the login attempt record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the login attempt record was deleted for audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_email_verification_tokens
models.description:
Email verification tokens for new account registration and account updates.

Stores one-time tokens used during email verification processes to confirm user-provided email addresses. Each token is associated with a specific email address and is valid until expiration or usage. Tokens are generated upon registration or email update requests, sent to the user, and consumed upon successful verification.

The verification process validates the token against the associated email, checks expiration time, and marks the token as used to prevent reuse. This table enables the system to securely link email verification with user identity without requiring persistent stored passwords during the registration flow.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address associated with the verification token. Required for identifying verification context.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: One-time verification token generated for email confirmation. Must be unique across all tokens.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the token expires and becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: is_used
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the token has been successfully used for email verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token record was soft-deleted. Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product records with name, description, category association and base attributes.

Manages the primary product catalog including product details, descriptions, and their categorization for storefront organization. Each product entry represents a unique product within the platform, supporting search and filtering capabilities for customers.

Products are linked to their respective categories for hierarchical organization, facilitating product discovery and navigation across the catalog. Product variants (SKU) are managed separately per requirements, ensuring proper 3NF compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_category_id
foreignFields.description: Product category reference. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name as displayed to customers. Must be descriptive and unique within category for product identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description including key features, benefits, and usage instructions for customer information.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Product creation timestamp. Indicates when the product was added to the catalog.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Product last modification timestamp. Updates whenever product details change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Marks when product was removed from catalog for audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description:
Main category records representing product organization hierarchy.

Supports nested categories with parent-child relationships and associated section classification for product grouping and filtering. Each category can have subcategories, and the section association enables categorization within specific market channels.

Categories serve as primary entities in the product catalog, requiring independent creation, search, and management capabilities across the platform.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category for hierarchical organization. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

foreignFields.name: section_id
foreignFields.description: Section to which this category belongs for channel-specific organization. {@link shopping_mall_sections.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name used for display and user discovery. Must be unique within a section (enforced via unique index).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the category purpose, content, and target audience.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when category record was created. Used for sorting and determining age of categories.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when category record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when category was logically deleted. Used with soft delete pattern for audit preservation.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Product image files for catalog display and variant selection. Stores main product images, zoomable views, and image metadata for user-facing product pages. Images are associated with specific products to enable visual product representation across the shopping experience.

Images can be independently managed for catalog presentation, including adding new images, reordering existing ones, and removing obsolete images without affecting the core product data. The sort_order field enables intuitive gallery display ordering for users.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: Full URL or storage path to the image file on the server.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the image content for accessibility and SEO purposes.

plainFields.name: width
plainFields.description: Image width in pixels for responsive display.

plainFields.name: height
plainFields.description: Image height in pixels for responsive display.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Sequence number for displaying images in gallery order.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Image creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last image modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when image was soft-deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews and ratings for products with moderation support.

Stores customer feedback on products including ratings, textual comments, and status tracking for moderation workflows. Each review is tied to a specific product and authenticated customer, enabling independent user management of reviews without requiring product context.

Reviews can be updated by the original poster, moderated by staff for content quality, and searched across products. The status field tracks moderation state (pending, approved, rejected) while temporal fields provide complete audit trails for review history.

This table supports the primary user scenario where customers provide feedback and businesses track review quality through moderation capabilities.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numerical rating for the product (1-5 scale). Valid values: 1-5 integer.

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: Customer's written feedback on the product. Includes attribution-specific details and content for product validation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status of the review. Valid values: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_product_specs
models.description:
Technical specifications and variant-specific details for products, including attributes like color, size, and material compositions. Each specification is linked to a specific product variant to enable detailed product information lookup and filtering during catalog browsing.

Specifications are exclusively used to display product variant details to customers and support search/filtering capabilities in the product catalog. The table follows strict 3NF by separating specification attributes from product base records and tying them directly to variant entities, avoiding any denormalization.

All specifications are stored in raw format to support dynamic display based on current product variant configuration, with no pre-computed values or calculated fields.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Link to product variant. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: spec_name
plainFields.description: Name of the technical specification attribute (e.g., 'Color', 'Size', 'Material').

plainFields.name: spec_value
plainFields.description: Value of the technical specification (e.g., 'Red', 'Medium', 'Cotton').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the specification was created for the variant.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the specification was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the specification was soft deleted for audit purposes. Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_low_stock_alerts
models.description:
Configuration records for low stock alerts that trigger notifications when inventory for a product variant falls below a defined threshold. Each alert is associated with a specific product variant and defines the stock threshold, notification channel, and activation status.

Enables sellers to customize alert behavior for different product variants based on business needs and inventory policies. Alerts can be enabled/disabled to control notification frequency and reduce system noise during promotions or sales events.

The threshold field specifies the minimum inventory level that triggers an alert, while notification channels determine how the alert is delivered (email, SMS, etc.). All configuration changes are tracked through the temporal fields for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variants_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant this alert applies to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: threshold
plainFields.description: Minimum inventory level that triggers alert for this variant. Must be a positive integer representing stock quantity.

plainFields.name: notification_channel
plainFields.description: Preferred delivery method for alerts (e.g., 'email', 'sms', 'slack').

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Active status of this alert configuration. True = active, False = disabled.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert configuration was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_logs
models.description:
Audit trail recording all inventory changes including updates, adjustments, and stock deductions.

This table captures historical modifications to product inventory levels, providing a complete record of stock movements for audit purposes. Each log entry is linked to a specific product variant inventory record and documents the nature of changes, performers, and timestamps.

The audit trail supports compliance requirements by tracking who performed inventory operations and when, while maintaining read-only access to historical change records.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_variant_inventories_id
foreignFields.description: Related inventory variant record. {@link shopping_mall_variant_inventories.id}

plainFields.name: change_description
plainFields.description: Specific details of inventory change including quantities and reasons for the adjustment.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: User role who performed the inventory operation (seller, admin).

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the actor performing the inventory change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory activity was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory activity log was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log record was marked for deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_adjustments
models.description:
Manual inventory adjustments recorded by sellers for product variants.

Tracks sellers' actions to modify product variant stock levels, capturing the type of adjustment (increase/decrease), quantity, and business reason. Each record links to the specific product variant and seller, enabling audit trails and reconciliation against automatic stock updates. Adjustments are soft-deleted to maintain historical context while allowing content moderation for internal review processes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant being adjusted. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who performed the adjustment. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: adjustment_type
plainFields.description: Type of adjustment, such as 'increase' or 'decrease'.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Magnitude of the stock change (positive for increase, negative for decrease).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business justification for the adjustment, such as 'manual stock count', 'returned items', or 'trial adjustment'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the adjustment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the adjustment record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the adjustment record was soft-deleted (null indicates active).

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_inventories
models.description:
Tracks real-time stock levels and availability status for each product variant.

Monitors inventory quantities and status changes for product variants, enabling immediate stock updates and visibility. Each record represents a single product variant's current inventory state, independent of other variants. This table supports real-time inventory checks during checkout and purchase processes.

Status values include 'in_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'low_stock', and 'discontinued'. Stock level changes are recorded as audit events in 'shopping_mall_inventory_logs' for traceability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variants_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant record. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: current_stock
plainFields.description: Current available quantity of the product variant. Must be zero or positive.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current inventory status. Valid values: 'in_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'low_stock', 'discontinued'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this inventory record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this inventory record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this inventory record was soft-deleted. Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Main order records with customer, seller, and order details.

Stores the core information about each customer's purchase including product selection details, payment status, shipping information, and processing status. Each order is initiated by a customer from their profile (shopping_mall_customers) and fulfilled by a seller (shopping_mall_sellers).

Orders contain a running status for fulfillment workflows (pending → processing → shipped → delivered) and maintain a historical record through the associated snapshot table. The order tracking system supports cancellation requests and refund processing while preserving the original order data.

The transaction amount is calculated based on product line items and includes applicable taxes and discounts.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who fulfilled the order. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status: pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount of the order including products and applicable taxes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for order status changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp if order is archived.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Line items for each product in an order, including variant-specific details and pricing information at the time of purchase.

Each line item represents a single product variant (SKU) purchased within the order, maintaining historical pricing for accurate billing and audit trails. The table associates products with orders through variants, capturing both item quantity and price at transaction time.

Supports order fulfillment tracking and billing reconciliation while preserving historical data integrity without redundant denormalization.

foreignFields.name: orders_id
foreignFields.description: Order context. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id.

foreignFields.name: product_variants_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant reference. {@link shopping_mall_products.id.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of items ordered. Must be positive integer representing quantity purchased.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at time of transaction. Records historical pricing, not current catalog price.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when line item was added to order.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last timestamp when line item data was modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail retention.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time historical records of order status changes for audit trails and change tracking.

Captures the exact state of an order at specific moments during its lifecycle including status, shipping details, payment information, and associated customer/seller data. Each snapshot is generated when an order transitions between statuses (e.g., from 'processing' to 'shipped').

Supports compliance requirements for order history analysis and dispute resolution. Snapshots are append-only and rarely modified, providing an immutable record of order progression.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this status snapshot belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status (e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled').

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment processing status related to this order snapshot (e.g., 'paid', 'pending', 'refunded').

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount paid for the order at the time of snapshot. Represents financial value in base currency.

plainFields.name: shipping_address
plainFields.description: Full shipping address associated with the order at the time of this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order status snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order status snapshot was last updated (typically same as created_at for snapshot).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was marked for soft deletion (if applicable).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellations
models.description:
Order cancellation requests initiated by customers or sellers.

Tracks all requests to cancel orders, including the reason, original order details, and processing status. Cancellation requests follow a workflow that may involve approval before the order is officially canceled.

Each cancellation request corresponds to a specific order and contains the reason provided by the customer or seller, along with the request timestamp. The status field tracks progress through the validation and processing workflow.

Requests can be in various states including pending (waiting for verification), approved (cancellation validated), or rejected (cancellation not permitted due to business rules or timing constraints). This table enables tracking of the entire cancellation lifecycle.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing cancellation request management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: cancellation_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by customer for cancellation request.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the cancellation request: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the cancellation request was submitted.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the request was processed.

plainFields.name: process_notes
plainFields.description: Internal notes about the cancellation processing decision.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the cancellation request.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation request was soft deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_refunds
models.description:
Records of customer-initiated refund requests with associated order and payment details for financial reconciliation.

Each refund request is tied to a specific order and payment transaction, tracking the refund amount, reason, and current status through the approval workflow. Refund requests maintain historical records even after order status changes or payment adjustments.

Refund status transitions follow business workflow rules: pending (initiated), approved (processed), rejected (denied). The system automatically initiates refunds when status moves to approved, triggering payment gateway communication.

This table supports full audit trail capabilities including creation timestamps and soft deletion for financial review purposes.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Associated order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Linked payment transaction's {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current refund status. Valid values: pending, approved, rejected. Follows business workflow state transitions.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Refund amount in platform currency, matching payment transaction value.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-specified reason for refund request. May include product issues or service dissatisfaction.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund request was initiated by customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund status was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund record was soft-deleted for audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_transactions
models.description:
Payment transaction records tracking all attempts, including success/failure status, gateway processing details, and associated order information.

Stores complete history of payment processing for audit trail and reconciliation. Each transaction links to an order and payment method, enabling financial reporting, dispute resolution, and partial refund tracking. Status transitions follow predefined workflow with explicit change logging.

Transaction state changes are permanently recorded through the audit trail, allowing recovery of historical data even if current status changes. Gateway response logs provide critical detail for debugging payment failures with external providers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order associated with this payment transaction. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: The payment method used for this transaction. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current payment status. Valid values: pending, processing, completed, failed, refunded.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Total amount processed, in platform currency.

plainFields.name: transaction_id
plainFields.description: External transaction ID from the payment gateway for reconciliation with third-party systems.

plainFields.name: gateway_response
plainFields.description: Raw response received from the payment gateway including error details on failures, stored for audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Payment initiation timestamp when transaction was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last status modification timestamp for transaction updates.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when transaction record is marked inactive.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_methods
models.description:
Configuration management for supported payment gateway integrations.

Stores system configurations for payment methods including API versions and integration details. Each payment method (Stripe, PayPal, Alipay) has unique configuration settings validated before use in payment processing. This table enables dynamic configuration of payment gateways without requiring code changes.

The name field identifies the payment method provider, while api_version specifies the required gateway API version. Configuration stores JSON-encoded settings for gateway integration including API keys, URLs, and merchant IDs.

Transaction processing associates payment methods through foreign keys while maintaining historical integrity. Soft delete supports administrator management of gateway configurations without data loss.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Payment method name (e.g., 'Stripe', 'PayPal', 'Alipay'). Must be unique across all payment methods.

plainFields.name: api_version
plainFields.description: API version specification for the payment gateway. Used to validate gateway compatibility during integration.

plainFields.name: configuration
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded configuration string containing API keys, endpoints, and integration parameters for the payment gateway.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current operational status of the payment method. Valid values: 'active', 'inactive', 'pending'. Determines if method can be used for transactions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was marked for deletion (soft delete). Supports audit trails and data recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description:
Tracks all refund requests submitted by customers including their status, processing timeline, associated payment details, and final outcomes.

Stores refund requests at the point of creation, capturing the financial details and customer's reason for the refund. Each request is uniquely linked to a single payment transaction (one-to-one reference). The refund workflow passes through several stages: pending (initial submission), processing (under review), approved (ready for refund), rejected (denied), and refunded (processed).

Systems can query refunds by status, date range, payment ID, or amount. Refund amounts must match the payment transaction's amount limits. Soft deletion allows refund tracking maintenance without data loss while enabling fraud monitoring and audit trails.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Associated payment transaction. {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current refund processing status. Valid values: pending, processing, approved, rejected, refunded.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's explanation for requesting a refund, including specific issues encountered with the purchase.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Refund amount requested in the payment's currency. Must not exceed payment transaction amount.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was submitted by the customer.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when processing of the refund request began.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund was successfully processed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Refund request creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Refund request last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Refund request deletion timestamp (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Product reviews and customer feedback records.

This table stores customer reviews for products, including ratings, titles, and detailed feedback. Each review is associated with a specific product and customer, allowing for independent management of feedback without requiring parent entity context.

Reviews can be created, edited, and deleted by customers directly through the application. The rating field provides a numeric score (1-5) reflecting the customer's satisfaction with the product. Textual feedback allows detailed descriptions of the customer's experience.

Unlike some entities where child records might be subsidiary, reviews require independent management as customers might want to search all reviews from a specific user, or filter reviews by rating across products.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this review is associated with. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who created the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numerical rating provided by customer (1-5). Higher values indicate better satisfaction.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief summary or title for the review. Optional but recommended.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed textual feedback from the customer about the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the review.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_comments
models.description:
Comments made on product reviews by customers or sellers.

Stores user comments on product reviews to enable
discussion and feedback about the review itself.
Each comment is associated with a specific review
and can be made by either a customer or seller.

Comments remain attached to the review even if the review
is edited or deleted, providing historical context.
Users can reply to comments to create threaded discussions.
The comment content includes body field for textual
feedback. Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit
trails while allowing comment moderation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Review being commented on. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor making the comment (customer or seller).

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Text content of the comment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was soft-deleted (null if not deleted).

models.name: shopping_mall_review_votes
models.description:
Tracks user votes on product reviews to indicate helpfulness (positive/negative).

Stores each vote as a separate record associated with a specific review.
Each vote can be marked as positive or negative to help other users assess review quality.
Votes are tracked using session IDs for user tracking but not directly tied to session IDs for this table.
Users can only vote once per review through their sessions, and vote types can be revised.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Review being voted on. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}

plainFields.name: vote_type
plainFields.description: Type of vote. Valid values: 'positive', 'negative'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this vote was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this vote was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this vote was soft-deleted (null if not deleted).

models.name: shopping_mall_review_moderation_logs
models.description:
Audit logs tracking all moderation actions taken on product reviews.

Captures details of review content modifications, flagging actions, and moderator decisions. Each log entry records when and by whom a moderation action was performed, with full audit trail capabilities for compliance and review purposes.

Logs are never edited directly by users - they are append-only historical records tied to the original review's state. The moderation log references the review itself to provide context for why an action was taken.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewed product review's {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Moderation action performed (e.g., 'flagged', 'hidden', 'approved', 'edited').

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the moderation action, including specific policy violations.

plainFields.name: moderator_id
plainFields.description: Moderator's identity (references to shopping_mall_admins or shopping_mall_seller_sessions.id).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the moderation action was performed.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this log entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was soft-deleted (for compliance audit trails).
